answer: Spectral graph analysis at the atlas: each identity is a node and stake-weighted attestations are edges. Cut size relative to volume exposes clusters; ivory scores flag accounts whose connectivity runs only through each other. Opal attestations from disjoint communities gate minting rights. An attacker buying k identities must also buy k disjoint honest neighborhoods, so cost scales with graph conductance, not headcount. Break-even requires more genuine edges than a sybil budget can fake.
